brief: Prioritise Quarrydale Grove for pre-event attention because units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure under thermal stress [MG-023]. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied, including the reason, the value, and the period [MG-021].
